definition_quote.value: 'Practice of optometry' means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures: (i) The examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions ... (ii) The employment of objective or subjective physical means to determine the accommodative or refractive conditions ... (iii) The adaptation or the adjustment of the lenses or prisms or the use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents ... (iv) The examination of the human eye for contact lenses and the fitting or insertion of contact lenses ... (v) The employment of objective or subjective means, including diagnostic pharmaceutical agents ...
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures

drug_authority.value: Optometrists certified under section 17412 may administer diagnostic pharmaceutical agents. Optometrists certified under section 17435 may administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, including topical drugs, topical/oral antiglaucoma drugs, and certain oral prescription drugs. Controlled substances in schedules 3, 4, and 5 (including dihydrocodeinone combination drugs) are included; schedule 2 controlled substances, oral cortical steroids are excluded.
drug_authority.quote: "Drug" means that term as defined in section 17703, but does not include a controlled substance as defined in section 7104 and included in schedule 2 under section 7214, an oral cortical steroid, or a prescription drug. However, drug does include a controlled substance included in schedules 3, 4, and 5 under sections 7216, 7218, and 7220, respectively, and dihydrocodeinone combination drugs.

surgery_definition.value: 'Invasive procedures' means: (i) The use of lasers other than for observation. (ii) The use of ionizing radiation. (iii) The use of therapeutic ultrasound. (iv) The administration of medication by injection. (v) Procedures that include an incision.
surgery_definition.quote: "Invasive procedures" means all of the following: (i) The use of lasers other than for observation. (ii) The use of ionizing radiation. (iii) The use of therapeutic ultrasound. (iv) The administration of medication by injection. (v) Procedures that include an incision.
